parameters.jsCode: const a=$input.first().json.added||[];const m=a.map(t=>({date:t.date,amount:t.amount,name:t.merchant_name||t.name,category:(t.personal_finance_category&&t.personal_finance_category.primary)||'UNCATEGORIZED'}));const c='Analyzing family spending (SANDBOX test data). '+m.length+' transactions follow as JSON. Return ONLY a JSON object with keys totals_by_category (object mapping category to number), top_merchants (array of objects with name and total), observations (array of short strings), and recommendations (array of short advisory strings). Amounts are absolute dollars. Recommendations are advisory only, never actions. Do not include account numbers or identifiers. Transactions: '+JSON.stringify(m);return [{json:{transaction_count:m.length,transactions:m,claude_user_content:c}}];

nodes.name: Minimize Transactions
nodes.notes: Strips each transaction down to date, amount, merchant name, and category ONLY. Drops account_id, transaction_id, and every other identifier before anything leaves this node. This is the minimization boundary before data is sent to Anthropic.

nodes.name: Prepare File Data
nodes.notes: Formats the transactions array as a stringified JSON object in a 'data' property for the ReadWriteFile node.

nodes.name: Persist To Atlas
nodes.notes: Writes the MINIMIZED transactions (no identifiers) to /automation/finance/ inside the container, which maps to /opt/automation/finance/ on the atlas host. Sandbox data only. The finance/ subdirectory must exist and be writable by the node user.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "model": "claude-opus-4-8", "max_tokens": 4096, "system": "You are a careful family-finance analyst. Output only valid JSON matching the user schema. Recommendations are advisory only, never actions or money movement. Never echo account numbers or identifiers.", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": $json.claude_user_content } ] } }}

nodes.name: Claude Analysis
nodes.notes: Anthropic Messages API. Header Auth credential 'Anthropic API Key' auto-injects x-api-key header. Sends the MINIMIZED transactions only. Model is claude-opus-4-8; swap to claude-haiku-4-5 in the jsonBody to cut cost ~5x for this categorization task.

meta.description: Sandbox-only. Syncs transactions for 'Plaid Sandbox Item 1', minimizes each to date/amount/merchant/category (dropping all identifiers), persists the minimized set to a file on the atlas host, and sends the minimized set to Claude (Anthropic Messages API) for categorization plus advisory recommendations. AI analyzes; humans execute. No money movement. Manual trigger, inactive by default.
